name: Poland
description: Poland is a parliamentary republic in Central Europe and the largest economy in the Visegrad Group, known for one of the fastest sustained growth records in the European Union. Its post-1989 transition from a centrally planned to a market economy produced a diversified industrial base in automotive, machinery, chemicals and food processing, deep integration into European and German-led value chains, and a growing business-services sector.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Poland’s actor space from partitions and statehood through communist rule to post-1989 market transition and EU integration.

works.title: Industrial and Technology Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of Poland’s automotive and machinery clusters, special economic zones, business-services sector and integration into European value chains.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of voivodeships, metropolitan regions, transport corridors and the spatial concentration of industrial clusters.
